locked_visual.presentation: G-rated anthropomorphic flamingo completely covered in natural feathers
locked_visual.build: average healthy flamingo build; neither lanky-thin nor muscular
locked_visual.head: compact mature flamingo head with fine feather texture
locked_visual.eyes: small expressive avian eyes with visible sclera, distinct iris and pupil, one restrained catchlight, and controlled eyelid acting
locked_visual.beak: recognizable flamingo beak with pale proximal section and dark downturned distal section
locked_visual.neck: long, slim, pronounced smooth S-curve; unmistakably flamingo
locked_visual.arms: flexible wing-arms built from layered contour and flight feathers
locked_visual.hands: three articulated feather-digits: one short thumb-feather and two longer finger-feathers; tiny pale avian nail tips
locked_visual.legs: long flamingo legs with webbed bird feet
locked_visual.base_model: natural feather covering with bow tie only; clothing is never baked into anatomy
locked_visual.rendering: hand-drawn black pen and graphite-like line variation, restrained gray ink wash, warm off-white paper

controlled_performance.gesture_style: economical, articulate, readable silhouettes; wing-hands remain feathered
controlled_performance.smile_rule: smiles are created through the beak seam, cheek feather lift, eyelids, and posture; never human lips or teeth
controlled_performance.signature_prop: classic martini with exactly three olives on one pick when the scene calls for it

scene_variables.clothing: dictated by the scene; fits over the canonical body and never replaces the bow tie
scene_variables.props: dictated by the scene; the martini is optional unless specified
scene_variables.pose: dictated by action using approved anatomy
scene_variables.location: bar, golf course, fishing setting, travel setting, or another explicitly requested environment
scene_variables.camera: front, three-quarter, profile, back, seated, close-up, medium, or wide
scene_variables.expression: selected from the approved expression system

forbidden_drift: round parrot, duck, pelican, or stork beak
straight, short, thick, or swan-like neck
giant alien eyes, all-black bead eyes, or fully human eyes
human arms, bare human hands, palms, or five fingers
separate extra wings behind the wing-arms
long claws, talons, manicured nails, black nail tips, or nail polish
bodybuilder physique, extreme thinness, pot belly, or juvenile proportions
missing bow tie or patterned/color bow tie
permanent suit or clothing added to the base anatomy
teeth, lips, moustache, hair, or human ears
color artwork, glossy 3D rendering, vector-flat art, anime, or photorealism
mean, cruel, frantic, foolish, or cynical default demeanor
more or fewer than three olives when the signature martini is present
